name: eureka-detailed-results
reviewedBy: Round-6 prose repair implementer, not independent acceptance
rationale: The 2026-09-27 RL motion pass replaced the qualification ', not strict wins everywhere' after the Eureka detailed-results clause with the sentence 'Some were ties.'. No retained Eureka passage reports ties: the corrected eureka-2024 row of audit/rl-sim2real.md records only that the detailed results match or exceed the human reward on all nine Isaac tasks and 15 of the 20 Dexterity tasks, which is not a strict win everywhere. The restore deletes that one sentence, so the retained matching-or-exceeding wording again carries the qualification. That three-word deletion alone would lift the article from 1.999 to 2.002 structural tells per 1,000 words, above the 2-per-1,000 floor the build and the RL prose unit test enforce, so the terrain-curriculum sentence also drops its 'rather than guessed' contrast and states only that thousands of parallel robots make the difficulty frontier measurable, which the retained Rudin curriculum passage of audit/rl-sim2real.md:424 supports; the article then measures 1.60. Every other sentence, number, citation (in order), mount and the frontmatter are byte-preserved. The archived pre-restore bytes are exactly the current endpoint the unchanged RL motion continuity review records, and that review still gates them; the live article keeps every phrase that review requires. No proof, receipt, verdict or ledger cell changed.
